# POST /api/v1/orgs

Create a new organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (reqToken) · **ID:** `ep-030`

## Response

**201** — *api.Organization

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Organization ID |
| `name` | string | Organization name |
| `full_name` | string | Full display name |
| `email` | string | Email address |
| `avatar_url` | string | Avatar URL |
| `description` | string | Description |
| `website` | string | Website URL |
| `location` | string | Location |
| `visibility` | string | Visibility level |
| `repo_admin_change_team_access` | bool | Whether repo admins can change team access |

- **403** — User not allowed to create organizations
- **422** — Username already exists, reserved, or contains invalid chars/pattern

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Only users with AllowCreateOrganization=true (or admins) can create organizations | authorization | !ctx.Doer.CanCreateOrganization() |
| CanCreateOrganization checks admin status OR (AllowCreateOrganization AND !DisableRegularOrgCreation) | business_logic | u.IsAdmin || (u.AllowCreateOrganization && !setting.Admin.DisableRegularOrgCreation) |
| Organization username must be usable (not reserved, valid chars, valid pattern) | validation | user_model.IsUsableUsername(org.Name) returns error |
| Organization username must not already exist as any user type | validation | user_model.IsUserExist(ctx, 0, org.Name) returns true |
| Default visibility is public if not specified in create request | business_logic | form.Visibility == "" |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| User cannot create orgs | 403 | forbidden | False |
| Username taken | 422 | validation error | False |
| Username is reserved | 422 | validation error | False |
| Invalid characters in name | 422 | validation error | False |

### Error Paths

- **User cannot create organizations** → ctx.APIError → 403
- **Username already exists** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Name reserved/invalid chars/pattern** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Database error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
